from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,subprocess,sys,base64
p=Path.cwd(); ids=set(json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids']); found=[]
def wr(n,s):
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr

for f in sorted(root.glob('mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl')):
 data=f.read_bytes(); ch=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
 for i,line in enumerate(data.splitlines(keepends=True),1):
